set.body: Design and implement a Scala 3 multivariate analysis layer for ScalaFIM. Scope: typed vector spaces, sparse-preserving preprocessing, map/projector algebra, decomposition products, multiblock extension, row-side effect operators, and a JVM/Spark-friendly execution boundary. Non-goals: no Spark types in shared code, no direct R S3 surface, no estimator logic hidden inside preprocessing or projectors. This epic is closed only when the child slices and final architecture/parity audit are complete.
set.title: EPIC: Multivariate type core for ScalaFIM
